## Get in touch

- Postdoctoral fellows  

- PhD and MPhil students

<br>
I would be happy to hear about your **research interests, skills and plans**.<br>

Prospective postdocs and PhD/MPhil students are encouraged to read [our publications](publications.html) and [contact me](mailto:chensichong0528@gmail.com) before applying officially. Please briefly explain how your research experience and interests align with our work. **Generic enquiries without a clear connection to our research may not receive a response.**

<hr>

## Who we are looking for

- We welcome applicants from deverse backgrounds including ecology, statistics, computer science and related disciplines, who are motivated to pursue fundamental questions in ecology.

- Backgrounds in species interactions, entomology, microbiome or macroevolution are particularly welcome. Skills in field experiments, artificial intelligence, large-scale data mining and database integration are highly valued.

- We encourage applicants to **develop their own research ideas** that complement the broader themes of the group.

- **Part-time research assistants:** Occasional positions may be available. Applicants must already have the legal right to work in Hong Kong, as visa sponsorship is not available for these positions.

<hr>

## Admissions & Scholarships at HKU

- [PhD/MPhil admission](https://gradsch.hku.hk/prospective_students/application/how_to_apply)

- [HKU Presidential PhD Scholar Programme](https://gradsch.hku.hk/prospective_students/fees_scholarships_and_financial_support/hku_presidential_phd_scholar_programme)

- [Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme](https://gradsch.hku.hk/prospective_students/fees_scholarships_and_financial_support/hong_kong_phd_fellowship_scheme)

Scholarships are competitive, with **major application deadlines typically in late November**. Applicants themselves should check the official websites for current deadlines and eligibility.

**Self-funded PhD/MPhil applications may also be considered**, subject to HKU admission requirements. Funded MPhil opportunities are particularly limited.
